reason: Conversation 1 directed the customer to the hidden pump sump cover, which is the key step in this case, and the customer found slimy water and fluff there and wiped it, so the run time improved to about 60 minutes. It did escalate sensibly at the end, but it gave the customer less progress and less useful diagnosis.
